messages.弾丸を撃ち切ったときの「止まらない物語」、混乱か精神力-40未満の敵への「ばぁん: A Sinking and Tremor Identity that adds damage beyond her selected skills through three follow-ups: Stories that Never Cease when ammunition runs out, Bang. Bang. against Staggered enemies or those below -40 SP, and Magnificent End at 30 Petals. Particularly suited to Sinking teams.
messages.弾丸-孤独と「止まらない物語」: 弾丸-孤独を6保有し、S1「ばぁん。ばぁん。」: **Ammo - Solitude and Stories that Never Cease**: She holds 6 Ammo - Solitude, spending 1 each with Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ of S1 Bang. Bang. and 1 with Coin Ⅰ of S2 Blossoming Fragrance in the Void. If it is 0 at the end of her attack, she makes a one-sided attack with Stories that Never Cease (an Unfocused Volley with 3 Coins), then spends 10 SP to Reload. It inflicts Solitude, and enemies without SP or in Solitude Panic gain Sinking Count at Turn End.
messages.「ばぁん。ばぁん。」の追撃: 弾丸-孤独が1以上のときだけ、自分または味方の攻撃: **Bang. Bang. follow-up**: Only while she has at least 1 Ammo - Solitude, at the end of her or an ally's attack skill, if an enemy's SP is below −40 or it is staggered, she makes a one-sided attack with Bang. Bang., once per turn.
messages.花びらと「恍惚とした終末」: バトルパッシブ「枯れない花」(怠惰×1・憂鬱×2・: **Petals and Magnificent End**: Through the combat passive Unwithering Flower (1 Sloth and 2 Gloom Owned), she gains Petals: 1 from enemy Sinking damage, an amount equal to the enemy's Faint Aroma, and 2 from Tremor Burst, up to 15 per turn, with +1 Offense Level per 10. If she has at least 30 at the end of her attack, she triggers Magnificent End against the enemy with the most Faint Aroma.
messages.残香: S2・S3「満開」で付与(最大30)。沈潜ダメージを受けると増え、振動爆: **Faint Aroma**: Inflicted by S2 and S3 Full Bloom, up to 30. It increases when the bearer takes Sinking damage, and on Tremor Burst it spreads 1–2 Faint Aroma to 3 random enemies other than that one. S2 and S3 gain +1% damage per Faint Aroma.
messages.守備「芸・観・時」: ターン終了時に花びら10と、次のターンの脆弱2・攻撃威力増: **Defense skill — A.A.T.**: At Turn End, she gains 10 Petals, plus 2 Fragile and 2 Attack Power Up for the next turn. Magnificent End checks at the end of her attack, so reaching 30 at Turn End does not trigger it right away.
messages.S1・S2で弾丸を減らしながら沈潜回数・振動・残香を積み、撃ち切ったら止まらない: Stack Sinking Count, Tremor, and Faint Aroma with S1 and S2 while spending Ammo, and chain into Stories that Never Cease once she runs dry. If an enemy is staggered, Bang. Bang. also follows allies' attacks. On the turn before Petals reach 30, use her Defense skill, then unleash Magnificent End next turn with 2 Attack Power Up active. Petals are capped at 15 per turn, so if she has already gained more than 5 that turn from attacks, part of the Defense skill's +10 is cut off by the cap. Each Reload costs SP, so manage SP while counting Unwithering Flower's recovery (3% HP and 10 SP on a turn she loses at least 10% of her max HP, once per turn).
